_readme: Risk acceptances for the dependency gate (scripts/audit-gate.js, FedRAMP plan A1 · RA-5, SI-2; GovRAMP D3). One entry per advisory and package, with why the risk is accepted and the date it must be reviewed by. High and critical: CI fails without a current entry, and again once it expires. Low and moderate never fail CI; an entry records the acceptance, and without one (or once it expires) the advisory shows as unreviewed in every release's notes. Remove an entry once the advisory is fixed.

exceptions.reason: XSS through Quill's HTML export (getSemanticHTML); quill 2.0.3 is the latest release and has no fix. Downgrading is not a fix: the advisory names only the version it was reported on, and react-quill-new needs ~2.0.2. Mitigated: the post editor's HTML is inserted in one place only, DisplayArticle.jsx, always through DOMPurify.sanitize; script-src allows no inline script. GovRAMP decision D3, proposed 2026-11-10; approved by merging the PR that adds this entry.
